output.reason: Highly resolved luxury perfume still-life featuring intricate crystal engraving and dramatic chiaroscuro lighting. Excellent reference for material detail and high-contrast product photography, despite the absence of campaign typography.

analysis.composition: Asymmetrical placement with the subject anchored to the left, balanced by expansive negative space on the right. Includes a subtle surface reflection at the base.
analysis.negative_space: Dominant solid black void occupying the right half and upper background, providing high contrast and potential copy space.
analysis.lighting: Dramatic low-key studio lighting utilizing rim light and backlighting to accentuate the refractive qualities of the cut glass and the amber tone of the liquid.
analysis.typography: None visible. No external campaign text or overlays present.
analysis.information_density: Low. Focus is entirely on the singular object and its material properties.
